verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales documents configurable dashboards and in-app KPI views on leads and opportunities. Copilot surfaces conversion and win rates and pipeline updates through natural-language queries, so some insight is available without a spreadsheet. However, a custom report builder is not documented, activity reporting is not evidenced, and the KPI view itself points to Excel export. missing for 10: documented custom report-building capability, dashboards specifically covering activity metrics, explicit pipeline/conversion dashboard charts (beyond Copilot Q&A), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Easily configure fields, dashboards, and views to match your organization’s sales methodology.
View KPI data on contacts, leads, and opportunities
Get insights into forecasts and team metrics like conversion and win rates by querying Copilot using natural language or prebuilt prompts.
Review open sales tasks, new assignments, and pipeline updates by querying Microsoft Copilot using natural language or prebuilt prompts.
